All fixed. Clean properly deletes the 3 generated `.g.cs` files, rebuild regenerates them, and no CS2002 warnings.

**Summary of fixes:**

| Issue | Root Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **6 validations instead of 3** | Cross-product batching: `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` × `%(ValidationRule.Filename)` | Batch on `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` only; use `@(ValidationRule)` as a list |
| **CS2002 duplicate warnings** | `<Compile Include="**\*.g.cs">` re-adds files already in SDK glob | Changed to `<Compile Update="**\*.g.cs">` |
| **FileWrites not tracked** | Static ItemGroup — not recorded by `_CleanRecordFileWrites` | Moved `FileWrites` into the `GenerateProtoCode` target |
| **Clean doesn't delete files** | `<Compile Remove>` only removes items, doesn't delete from disk | Replaced with `<Delete Files="..."/>` |
| **Missing AutoGen metadata** | Generated files added without metadata in target | Added `<AutoGen>true</AutoGen>` inline in target ItemGroup |
